symptom: Travel Speed Does Not Change, or Travel Speed is Too Slow or Fast
detail_of_failure: Travel speed does not change, or travel speed is too slow or fast.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • Travel PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01882) • F pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01100) • R pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01101)

steps.procedure: 1. Open the LS-EPC Solenoid Current screen. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “How to Examine Monitoring Information” of “Service Mode”. 2. Start the engine. 3. Set the working mode to P. 4. Fine operate the travel lever to do the troubleshooting. 5. Does the measurement result of the LS-EPC voltage value agree with the standard value? 6. Do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Testing and adjusting pump LS control circuit pressure”. 7. Does the measurement result of the LS-EPC valve output pressure agree with the standard value?
